page.overview:
Who is Bowser Monument?

The Bowser Monument, (also named Lava Bowser or Bowser Golem) is a character who first appears in Mario Kart 8.

The Bowser Monument is a massive Bowser Statue composed of molten rock, with visible lava highlights.

Unlike Bowser Statues or the comparable Mechanical Bowser from Mario Kart: Double Dash!!, the Bowser Monument attacks by punching the race course, causing the road to shake, instead of breathing fireballs. The Bowser Monument can also punch a Dash Panel on each side of the track.

Bowser Monument is found in Bowser's Castle. It is the centerpiece of the course, where it appears in the middle of the two paths. The Bowser Monument is the first shown during the course's intro. Racers can perform tricks off of the ripples created by the Bowser Monument.
